title: Egg, spinach and pepper breakfast wraps
description: Soft scrambled eggs with peppers, onion and spinach rolled into small flour tortillas, two per serving.
freeze_note: Wrap each wrap in foil before freezing.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Wrap each one in foil to freeze.

steps.text: Dice the bell pepper and onion and roughly chop the spinach. Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Cook the pepper and onion until soft, 4 to 5 minutes. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, about 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until fully set with no runny egg left, 3 to 4 minutes.
Warm the tortillas on a dry pan about 30 seconds per side. Spoon the filling down the middle and roll them up tightly.
Pack 2 wraps per container. To freeze, wrap each one in foil first.
Cool completely, then refrigerate or freeze.
Reheat in short microwave bursts, turning once, until hot throughout. From frozen, thaw overnight in the fridge first.
